title.description: Deck title (usually the paper's contribution in one line).

audience.description: Who the talk is for; drives terminology level.

slide_count_limit.description: Hard page cap from the case.

title.description: The page-level claim, not a section label.

bullets.description: Short speakable phrases, not full sentences.

image.description: Optional path to a figure/table image reused on the page.

notes.description: Speaker notes: transition, emphasis, backup evidence; must NOT repeat page text.

source_id.description: Exact label as in the paper, e.g. Fig. 3, Table 2, Eq. (7), Sec. 3.2.

quote.description: Verbatim value/conclusion copied without rewriting numbers or units.
